summary: Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Joshua Girnun and Donal Carroll to its Board of Directors and the reconstitution of its Audit, Nominating, and Compensation Committees. The appointments are described as part of a board renewal ahead of the annual meeting. No price, stake, premium, deal terms, or transactional structure are provided. The filing is a routine governance update and does not reflect an activist campaign or abrupt management change.
